chunks: And from him, from al-Humani, from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from al-Ajlah, from Abdullah ibn [Abi] al-Hudhayl, who said:
Judgment Day will not arrive until all the believers gather in Kufa.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the arrival of Judgment Day regarding the believers in Kufa?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights Kufa’s eschatological centrality as the gathering point for all believers prior to the Qiyamah, reflecting its historical status as the heart of Shia political and spiritual resistance. The phrase 'all believers' (kullu mu'min) is interpreted by scholars as either the totality of the faithful of the era or a representative assembly, underscoring the city's unique role in the final cosmic order.
